verdict.rationale: Muse is itself a personal AI agent, so it fills the MCP client role; serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows Muse running as an MCP server, and the probe found no MCP discovery surface (the server card returned 404), so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
